nodes.label: calib_state byte encoding
nodes.rationale: SPEC §23 lists only the field name; bit 7 = last attempt rejected

nodes.label: Gyro bias procedure (G, SEM < 0.05 °/s)
nodes.rationale: Std error of mean rather than raw std; boot auto-cal only replaces bias if still

nodes.label: T-03 axis mapping procedure
nodes.rationale: Mag uses opposite-heading differences to cancel hard iron, hemisphere independent

nodes.label: Software layers (App/Fusion/Sensors/Bsp/Core)
nodes.rationale: Dependencies point downward only; Sensors and Fusion compile on host

nodes.label: Telemetry framing 84 B, sync AA55, CRC16 (§23.2)
nodes.norm_label: telemetry framing 84 b, sync aa55, crc16 (§23.2)

nodes.label: bmp280_init=ld_bmp280_init define
nodes.rationale: LibDriver's bmp280_init(bmp280_handle_t*) collides with the wrapper API bmp280_init(void)

nodes.label: Reproducibility (§15)
nodes.rationale: Byte-identical builds; pin toolchain; record git describe as BUILD_GIT_DESC

nodes.label: Bench tool versions (gcc 15.2.0, CMake 4.3, Ninja, OpenOCD)
nodes.norm_label: bench tool versions (gcc 15.2.0, cmake 4.3, ninja, openocd)

nodes.label: Migration from CubeIDE baseline (§17)
nodes.rationale: Two build descriptions drift and the .ioc becomes ambiguous; do not keep both

nodes.label: Host-side unit testing (§12)
nodes.rationale: Main reason to prefer CMake: pure logic compiled natively and tested at full speed without target

nodes.label: BR-09 test vector per numeric algorithm
nodes.norm_label: br-09 test vector per numeric algorithm

nodes.label: Measured accel/gyro/mag matrices
nodes.rationale: LSM303AGR triads left-handed (det -1); never copy one sensor's matrix to another

nodes.label: D-7 Board matrices in App/board_axes.c
nodes.rationale: Fusion stays portable; T-03 values are board data, not algorithm

nodes.label: D-3 Keep CubeMX executable name
nodes.rationale: Name is CubeMX-generated; renaming fights regeneration

nodes.label: D-4 Flash/debug with OpenOCD
nodes.rationale: Q-2 default; matches bench; no license

nodes.label: Flash erase stalls scheduler (~40 ms)
nodes.rationale: Save only on S; stall compensated in ticks

nodes.label: Fault handling (§21.5)
nodes.rationale: Bus faults mark sensor not-OK, 1 s re-init, IMU-only fallback (NFR-15)

nodes.label: D-1 Own I3G4250D/LSM303AGR drivers, keep LibDriver BMP280
nodes.norm_label: d-1 own i3g4250d/lsm303agr drivers, keep libdriver bmp280
nodes.rationale: ST drivers return void and use global IO callbacks: cannot report bus faults or be host-tested; LibDriver BMP280 is handle-based with status returns

nodes.label: D-6 In-repo assert test harness
nodes.rationale: No dependency to pin; ctest < 5 s

nodes.label: Cooperative run-to-completion scheduler (TIM6 1 kHz)
nodes.rationale: ISR only increments volatile tick; no HAL_Delay after init

nodes.label: Headless CubeMX regeneration (§7.4)
nodes.rationale: Scripted, idempotent regeneration; diff check proves no hand edits in tool-owned files
